propositions: One-time backfill script must measure cyclomatic complexity (via lizard) and clone-count (via jscpd) at sampled historical commits and write snapshots to seed trend history.
Snapshot timestamp must be set to the commit's author/committer date (via git show -s --format=%cI), not wall-clock time, to preserve meaningful trend points.

measure_tree function must be a measurement seam that shells to lizard and jscpd, returning {"complexity": int, "clone_count": int} or None if tools fail; missing tools or errors cause commits to be skipped non-fatally.
All written snapshots must carry metadata labels source="snapshot" and confidence="high", and must be written through the same snapshot.py writer as going-forward measurements.
Sampled commits where measure_tree returns None (tool absent or errors) must be skipped and logged without aborting the backfill run.

Test suite must verify 3-snapshot write with correct per-commit ts values and integer-typed metrics, mutation-test the ts-equals-commit-date invariant with a narrow date window, and confirm skipped commits do not abort the backfill.
